statement: The official final result certified by the Landeswahlleiter of Saxony-Anhalt for the 2026-09-06 state election, certified between 2026-09-07 and 2026-09-30, allocates AfD at least 42 of the 83 Landtag seats.
resolution: TRUE if the amtliches Endergebnis published by the Landeswahlleiter Sachsen-Anhalt between 2026-09-07 and 2026-09-30 shows AfD holding 42 or more of 83 seats. Reference: 41 of 83 in the election-night projection.
failure_condition: The certified final seat allocation gives AfD 41 or fewer of the 83 seats, leaving it short of an absolute majority.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
